title: Publish with Release, Observe with Acquire
prompt: ISO C11. Implement the publish pattern: `void publish(atomic_int *flag, atomic_int *data, int payload)` stores payload into data (relaxed), then stores 1 into flag (release). `int observe(const atomic_int *flag, const atomic_int *data)` loads flag with acquire; when it sees 1 it must see the payload — return the data value, or -1 when flag is not yet 1.

tests.name: publish then observe
tests.hint: Release store to flag synchronizes-with the acquire load: 42 is visible.

tests.name: before publish
tests.hint: flag is still 0 — the observer must report not-ready as -1.

tests.name: payload survives republish
tests.hint: A second publish overwrites; the acquire load observes the newest release.
